items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: I didn't like his playing as well as I did Bad Frank.

ctx.x: Do you remember a fellow named Dave Perkins? I think he played trombone. Dave Perkins, yes.

He was an outstanding fellow at that particular time. He played. I didn't like his playing as well as I did Bad Frank. That's when I was little. I remember Dave Perkins when I was little. And they had a bass player, a colored bass player. I can't think of his name now. He was a light complected Creole sort of a fellow. He played a good bass. I used to admire him with the colored bands. He used to play a good bass and played the good notes, as I call them, you know.
Do you remember which band he played with?
